findings.claim: no machine guard distinguishes a VACUOUS battery member from an omitted one: the doctor proves membership, not that the member prints/verifies anything, so a future early-return regression inside any single tool's selfTest again exits the battery green

findings.justification: membership is what a static doctor can prove; verifying a member is non-vacuous needs its OUTPUT, and counting OK lines inside the battery chain would change the chain's exit semantics every hook depends on — the pin re-runs at done, and output-level checking is registered future work alongside issue #11's archaeology
